retainedBodies.heading: Record the episode, dose and bowel-directed route
retainedBodies.body: For an initial nonfulminant episode, the book lists vancomycin 125 mg orally four times daily for 10 days. Fulminant or complicated disease uses vancomycin 500 mg four times daily by a bowel-directed route together with metronidazole 500 mg IV every 8 hours. Oral, nasogastric and rectal vancomycin routes appear in the fulminant regimen; IV vancomycin is not an intestinal substitute. Review symptoms, episode history, severity and actual delivery before carrying a previous prescription into a new situation.
